title: lava test --json
description: The app's PHPUnit suite, as structured results rather than a summary line. The substrate is PHPUnit's `--log-junit` output — a documented format — so a reworded human summary can never silently break the framework. `cases` carries only the cases that did NOT pass: a green suite's payload stays small, and a reader sees the failures first.

testRun.description: One run of the app's suite.

suite.description: The configured suite's name when the app has exactly one, else null — with several there is no single answer, and `suites` carries them all rather than picking one.

suites.description: Every suite the app configured, in order.

cases.description: Only the cases that failed, errored, or were skipped — a passing case carries nothing a reader needs.

type.description: The throwable's class for a failure or error; empty for a skip.
